name: AI Headshot Hub

sources.title: Homepage — small live niche directory comparing AI headshot generators (~8 listings, category filters)
Submit a Listing — open form: contact info, listing name/URL, description, categories, logo, cover image, social links

requirements: Extreme niche: AI headshot generators / professional-headshot tools only (App, Editing Tools, Free Trial, Style Packs, Teams categories)
Required fields: user email, user name, listing name, listing URL
Optional: description, content, categories, logo upload or URL, cover image or URL, social links
No login required to submit — separate 'Business login' exists for managing listings
preparation: Description and longer content for the listing page
Logo file or logo URL; cover image or image URL
Category picks (App / Editing Tools / Free Trial / Style Packs / Teams)
workflow: Fill contact info (email, name) and basic info (listing name, URL, description, content)
Attach logo and cover image or paste their URLs
Pick categories, add social links, and click 'Submit your listing'
watchFor: Tiny directory — only ~8 listings; expect minimal referral traffic
Only useful if the product is literally an AI headshot/portrait generator — other AI tools do not fit
Homepage says 'Best AI Headshot Generators 2025' — content may be stale (© 2025)
Footer links twelve.tools — likely part of a small network of micro-directories
countsAsLive: The product has a page at aiheadshothub.com/listings/<slug>/ and shows in the homepage/category grids
unknowns: Review turnaround and whether submissions are moderated
Whether listing is always free — no pricing mentioned on the form
